gaps.sentence: The film didn't live up ___ my expectations.
gaps.explanation: live up TO something = be as good as expected.

gaps.sentence: The match kicks ___ at three o'clock.
Don't ___ up all the milk — we need some for breakfast.
gaps.explanation: use up = finish the whole supply of something.

gaps.sentence: Our street was cut ___ for three hours after the storm.
gaps.explanation: cut off = disconnected (power, phone); isolate (a village cut off by snow).

gaps.sentence: He loves showing ___ his new car to the neighbours.
gaps.explanation: show off = try to impress people with your abilities/possessions.

gaps.sentence: The gang gave ___ the stolen paintings to a gallery.
gaps.explanation: give away = give free of charge, or reveal (a secret).

gaps.sentence: Several runners passed ___ in the heat.
Can I ___ on these boots before buying them?
gaps.explanation: try on = put on clothes/shoes to check the fit.
